trust_decision.summary: Guardian.Plug.Keys decides whether a caller-supplied namespace key (binary/atom/any String.Chars, possibly request-derived via opts[:key] or Pipeline.put_key) may be interned as a new atom; at the pinned commit every key helper calls String.to_atom unconditionally.

landing_point.why: Summary names unbounded atom creation from binary keys; the String.to_atom calls in Keys.{claims,resource,token,base}_key are the obvious sink and the only String.to_atom hits under lib/guardian/plug.

fix_sites.entry_point: Guardian.Plug.current_token/2, authenticated?/2, VerifyHeader/VerifySession/VerifyCookie call (first `with` step), EnsureNotAuthenticated

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: lib/guardian/plug/verify_cookie.ex:113 (module deprecated at lib/guardian/plug/verify_cookie.ex:6-8 and :60), reached also from lib/guardian/plug/verify_header.ex:125 and lib/guardian/plug/verify_session.ex:84

O3_reason_to_dismiss: VerifyCookie is @deprecated and its session write happens only after a refresh token verified and exchanged, so a solver can argue it is legacy and only reached with a trusted key; also the write path (put_current_*) must create atoms because put_private requires atom keys.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: sign_out(:all) must still find namespaces stored under string keys (key_from_other must return the string when the bare atom does not exist rather than nil or raising); put-then-read with a dynamic key must round-trip; already-prefixed 'guardian_x' keys must not be double-prefixed; cookie lookup previously accepted both atom and string forms.

O6_input_shapes: suffixed private-map key atom/binary passed to key_from_other (guardian_<k>_token|_claims|_resource)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a Pipeline helper that derives the key from a request header/path param (e.g. put_key_from_header) and builds an atom itself before calling put_key
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: multi-tenant key selection is the documented use of keys (lib/guardian/plug/pipeline.ex:69-75); a maintainer adding a convenience helper could easily normalise with String.to_atom.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a resource-key derivation in LoadResource that builds its own "guardian_#{key}_resource" atom instead of calling Keys
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: a second implementation of the naming scheme in another plug file; plausible as a micro-optimisation or copy of Keys logic.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: decode path that skips do_validate_permissions! before String.to_atom on claim values
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: at the pinned commit the bound comes only from validation in lib/guardian/permissions.ex:295-297 and the known-key filter at lib/guardian/permissions.ex:176; removing it from one decode branch is a realistic how-type sibling (claim data from the token).

O9_family: CWE-770 resource exhaustion (BEAM atom-table exhaustion via String.to_atom on caller/request-influenced keys)

O10_build.toolchain: Elixir ~> 1.13 / Mix / Erlang OTP; deps jose ~> 1.11.9, plug, jason (test)
O10_build.project_tests: test/guardian/plug_test.exs, test/guardian/plug/verify_session_test.exs, test/guardian/plug/verify_cookie_test.exs, test/guardian/plug/verify_header_test.exs (ExUnit, Plug.Test); fix adds test/guardian/plug/keys_test.exs

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Swap every String.to_atom in keys.ex for String.to_existing_atom, which raises on unseen keys (crashes current_token/authenticated?), breaks put-then-read for new dynamic keys and makes sign_out(:all) drop string-keyed tenants; or leave the session/cookie name paths deriving atoms.

out_of_scope_notes: lib/guardian/permissions.ex:268 encode_permissions! calls String.to_atom on map keys before validation; input is developer-supplied permissions, separate sink.

After the published fix, put_current_* still interns atoms through token_key!/claims_key!/resource_key! (fix.diff:183-193); VerifyHeader/VerifySession/VerifyCookie write with the pipeline key after token verification (lib/guardian/plug/verify_header.ex:91-95). The fix documents this as developer-controlled (fix.diff:143-147) and did change these lines, so it is not listed as an O8 route.
